scenarios.assertion: Original ROS Controls PID and JointTrajectory interpolation run in Wasm; the guest verifies fresh real physics positions.
Missing joint_command capability returns DENIED with a warning; fresh physical positions remain unchanged.
Truncated device frames, invalid memory indices/ranges and stale handles are rejected without physical movement.
Wasm cancels its local trajectory, holds the observed stop pose and verifies a stable position away from the original target.
An authorized absent state topic produces no data; the Wasm monotonic deadline expires without a command.
An actual gateway exit yields DISCONNECTED; close retires the handle without corrupting the guest buffer.
The owner can still use its handle after another simultaneously running VM attempts to close or poll it.
A different live VM rejects the foreign handle and preserves output canaries.

additional_unqualified_dimensions: Complete native JointTrajectoryController source port and action-server lifecycle
Dynamic same-memory and independent multi-memory C++ component ABI
Other robot models, joint sets, grasping/navigation, physical hardware and production admission
scope: Original flexiv official MuJoCo robot model; original ROS Controls PID and trajectory interpolation and cancellation inside Wasm; native physics/device I/O only.
